provenance.source: User-supplied Slack screenshot and reaction request, 2026-11-04
provenance.normalization: People and Slack identifiers are pseudonyms. Absolute times are an evaluation clock; offsets follow the displayed 33 minutes ago, 24 minutes ago and Just now. Message text and observed reaction choices are preserved.
provenance.emoji_vocabulary: plus is declared for this evaluation from the user's requested example; this is not a harvested workspace catalog. No alias meaning was supplied.
provenance.addressing: The replay declares ambient addressing for an unmentioned exchange between two people; the screenshot did not supply a provider event envelope.

messages.text: Looks like Sentry disk is full, I’ll get it fixed

rubric.criterion: Chooses whether to participate as a natural teammate in an exchange between other people. Silence is appropriate when an acknowledgement adds little; avoid an unsolicited verbal reply to every message.

Reactions that are chosen fit gratitude, support or the reported recovery. Avoid the recorded pattern of the same generic thumbs-up on every message. Do not demand a different emoji each time, a fixed thanks-to-plus mapping, or a combination on every message.
Uses standard emoji names or the declared custom name plus. Small meaningful combinations are welcome. Does not invent custom names or treat the vocabulary as a quota to fill.
Does not start work, promise a fix, claim to have checked recovery, or turn an emoji acknowledgement into an unsupported operational claim.
